thread:
mike: Quick sync — we need to align version bumps across api, runtime, console, and SDKs. Targeting 0.15.0 for the cut tomorrow. Cutoff is 17:00 PT. Can folks confirm status?

sara: api PR is green and awaiting final approval: https://github.com/redwoodinc/api/pull/3421. I fixed the changelog entry and updated openapi tag. Will merge once runtime confirms compatible protocol header.

juan: runtime has a needed protocol tweak (kv-cache key format). I have a PR but still running perf regression checks: https://github.com/redwoodinc/runtime/pull/811. If perf looks good by 15:30 PT I can merge. Heads up: runtime binary names change in the helm chart too.

mike: thanks. if runtime is delayed we should still be able to ship api/console/SDKs with a compatibility shim — but prefer unified bump. @taylor any hot spots in SDKs for 0.15?

taylor: SDKs mostly just version bump + docs. PRs: https://github.com/redwoodinc/js-sdk/pull/129 and https://github.com/redwoodinc/python-sdk/pull/78. Need to update the samples and changelog. Will cut a release branch after api/runtime merge.

olivia: Console has UI copy for the new model-naming dropdown; branch is ready: https://github.com/redwoodinc/console/pull/504. But it references the new auth header name; will need a small compatibility layer if runtime is late.

rav (oncall): Canary plan — I can deploy a canary of runtime + api to staging cluster and exercise the top-50 endpoints. If we see >=1% error increase, we roll back. I’ll also enable extended logging for 30m post-deploy.

mike: perfect — canary sounds good. Sara/Taylor/Olivia, please add short smoke tests to your PRs so canary can exercise them automatically.

sara: done — added post-merge smoke test for /v1/generate and a quick token-perf check.

taylor: added a small test that hits streaming responses and function-calling bindings.

juan: perf job finished — no regression on 2k token runs. I pushed a tiny fix for concurrency edge case. Marking runtime PR ready: https://github.com/redwoodinc/runtime/pull/811

release-bot: Deployment plan created: release/0.15.0 (api,runtime,console,js-sdk,python-sdk). Cutoff 1962920400 (2026-03-17 17:00 PT). Canary window 30m.

mike: ok let's follow this order: 1) merge runtime -> nominate canary 2) merge api/console 3) cut sdk release branch 4) tagging and changelog finalization. If anything blocks, call it out here.

olivia: merging console now, will watch canary logs.

sara: merging api now.

taylor: SDK branches cut, starting publish dry-run.

rav (oncall): Canary deployed, hitting endpoints. Early signals look clean. No 5xx in first 10m.

mike: thanks everyone. If we stay green at +30m, proceed with final tag and prod rollout. Reminder to update the top-level changelog with bullet points (breaking: none; notable: runtime kv-key change, console UI dropdown).

sara: added changelog entry at docs/changelog/0.15.0.md

juan: pushed helm chart bump (values.image.tag: 0.15.0) and included migration note in k8s/README.md

taylor: publishing SDK releases now (dry-run succeeded). Will post final package links once published.

release-bot: Canary completed successfully. No rollout blockers detected. Proceeding to gradual rollout to prod tier-1.

mike: rolling to prod tier-1. If anyone sees elevated errors, post here and @rav will initiate rollback.

rav (oncall): monitoring. set alert thresholds to +0.5% error rate.

taylor: npm packages live: https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/sdk-js/v/0.15.0

taylor: pip wheels uploaded: https://pypi.org/project/redwood-sdk/0.15.0

olivia: console prod deployed, minor CSS tweak noted — filing a followup PR.

sara: prod api traffic looks stable. No errors > baseline.

juan: runtime metrics steady. KV hit ratio improved slightly.

mike: great ship. Postmortem/notes: everyone add 1-2 lines to the release thread in docs/releases/0.15.0.md about any manual steps you performed.

sara: will add notes about openapi tag change.

taylor: adding SDK publish caveats.

juan: adding helm/values note.

mike: thanks all :tada: \n
